rows.label: tlk4170042102_msg0001
rows.name:
Now then, everyone. Let's
try to express the scenery
of Liberalitas in writing.

rows.label: tlk4170042102_msg0002
rows.name:
You must choose your words so that
others can picture the scene in
their minds just by reading them.

rows.label: tlk4170042102_msg0003
rows.name:
If you're too direct, there's no
poetry to it. What matters is how
poetically you can express it!
